name: Packaging and Logistics Automation Line
summary: System integration solutions covering the entire process of post-production line packaging, conveying, and sorting for logistics automation.
contentHtml:
The packaging and logistics automation line is a system integration solution provided by TXAM for post-production logistics.

Solution Components

The system covers the entire process including automatic case opening, packing, sealing, labeling, sorting, conveying, palletizing, and warehouse docking.

Technical Advantages

  • Full-process automation, significantly improving logistics efficiency
  • High-speed sorting system with sorting accuracy above 99.9%
  • Intelligent conveying scheduling, high equipment utilization
  • Seamless integration with WMS system, transparent information
  • Modular design, flexible scalability
  • Full-line system integration, one-stop delivery

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, system integration, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.

painPoints.title: Packaging Efficiency Bottleneck
painPoints.desc: Manual packaging is slow and cannot meet the takt time requirements of high-speed production lines

painPoints.title: Insufficient Sorting Accuracy
painPoints.desc: Manual sorting has high error rates, reducing logistics efficiency

painPoints.title: Conveying Disconnection
painPoints.desc: Poor conveying between production line and warehouse, creating logistics bottlenecks

painPoints.title: Information System Fragmentation
painPoints.desc: Packaging, conveying, and sorting systems operate independently with no information sharing

painPoints.title: Low Space Utilization
painPoints.desc: Traditional logistics layouts occupy large spaces, reducing warehouse efficiency

painPoints.title: Poor Flexibility and Scalability
painPoints.desc: Difficulty adapting to capacity changes and business expansion needs

process.title: Automatic Case Opening

process.title: Automatic Packing

process.title: Intelligent Sorting

process.title: Automatic Conveying

process.title: Warehouse Docking
